title: Chapter 9 Revision: Health & Body
description: Mixed questions covering dative case, reflexive verbs się, boleć construction, modal verbs, and health vocabulary.

questions.prompt: Daję prezent ___ (I give a gift to my friend — m). [przyjaciel → dative]

questions.explanation: 'Siostra' → dative 'siostrze'. Feminine -a nouns: dative -ie/-e (with softening). 'Pomagam siostrze.'
'Jak się czujesz?' = How do you feel? Reflexive particle 'się' — same for all persons.
'Gorączka' = fever / high temperature. 'Mam gorączkę' = I have a fever.

questions.prompt: My head hurts. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: 'Boli mnie głowa.' — boli (singular), mnie (accusative of ja), głowa (subject). The person = accusative!

questions.prompt: My legs hurt. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: 'Bolą mnie nogi.' — bolą (plural body parts), mnie (accusative). 'Nogi' = plural, so 'bolą' not 'boli'.

questions.prompt: I must see a doctor. Which is correct?
questions.explanation: 'Muszę iść do lekarza.' = I must go to the doctor. 'Musieć → ja: muszę + infinitive (iść)'. 'Do lekarza' = genitive.
'Apteka' = pharmacy / chemist. 'Idę do apteki' = I'm going to the pharmacy.

questions.prompt: Nie ___ tu palić. (Smoking is not allowed here.)
questions.explanation: 'Nie można' = it is not allowed (impersonal). 'Nie można tu palić' = smoking is not allowed here.

questions.prompt: We laugh. Which is correct? [śmiać się]
questions.explanation: 'Śmiejemy się' = We laugh. 'Śmiać się' → my: śmiejemy się. 'Się' stays with the verb.

questions.prompt: Czy ___ mi pomóc? (Can you help me?)
questions.explanation: 'Możesz mi pomóc?' = Can you help me? 'Móc → ty: możesz'. 'Mi' = dative of 'ja'.
